course.title: Unit 6 Changing for the seasons--Lesson C-【例句】
course.description: Unit 6 Changing for the seasons--Lesson C-【例句】

sentences.content: We can go to Haikou in winter.
sentences.english: We can go to Haikou in winter

sentences.content: Yes, it's hot there. I can wear my new T-shirt.
sentences.english: Yes , it's hot there . I can wear my new T-shirt
sentences.chinese: 是的，那里很热。我可以穿我的新T恤了。

sentences.content: I can swim in the sea. I can eat seafood.
sentences.english: I can swim in the sea . I can eat seafood
sentences.chinese: 我能在海里游泳。我可以吃海鲜。

sentences.content: I like spring. It's warm and windy. I can go to the park and fly kites.
sentences.english: I like spring . It's warm and windy . I can go to the park and fly kites
sentences.chinese: 我喜欢春天。天气温暖，微风习习。我可以去公园放风筝。

sentences.content: I can wear my pink sweater and ...
sentences.english: I can wear my pink sweater and ...
sentences.chinese: 我可以穿上我的粉色毛衣……

sentences.content: I can talk about what people wear in different seasons.
sentences.english: I can talk about what people wear in different seasons
sentences.chinese: 我可以聊聊人们在不同季节的穿着打扮。

sentences.content: I can tell people about my favourite season.
sentences.english: I can tell people about my favourite season
sentences.chinese: 我可以告诉人们我最喜欢的季节。

sentences.content: I can talk about how seasons change our daily lives.
sentences.english: I can talk about how seasons change our daily lives
sentences.chinese: 我可以谈谈季节如何改变我们的日常生活。

sentences.content: I can read and spell words with "wh".
sentences.english: I can read and spell words with " wh "
sentences.chinese: 我能认读和拼写含有"wh"的单词。
